overall_notes: The extraction quality is generally good. The paper is primarily about the ToTTo dataset creation and evaluation of table-to-text generation models. Key contributions include: (1) A novel annotation process using iterative sentence revision, (2) Evaluation of multiple baseline models (BERT-to-BERT, Pointer-Generator, Puduppully et al.), (3) Both automatic (BLEU, PARENT) and human evaluation. The paper does not use LLMs as judges (published in 2020). All metadata is well-supported by the text.
